utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you send me the repair list first, then I can help figure out the time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—I can do that. I’ll check the flyer and send you the repair list as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—send the list when you find it, and I’ll take a look at the route time after that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve just heard it’s soon, and folks are sorting out the invite list and supplies. If you’re helping with donations, I can pass along the drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell — could you send me the exact drop-off times and the final repair list when you have them? Then I can figure out whether donations or pickup is best.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have the exact times or final list yet, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s right — still Saturday at Maple Hall from 10 to 2. I’m just waiting on the route and stop count before I can say if we need more people.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — I’m sorry I’m late. Once you have the latest list, just point me to the stop that needs the most hands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll do that — I’ll check the latest list and point you to the busiest stop as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday at the community center, right? I can help spread the word and keep it on the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Sunday at the community center sounds right. Thanks for helping spread the word and put it on the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll get it on the school schedule and mention it to a few parents, too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can keep spreading the word and point people toward the repair drive supplies. What needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — could you keep spreading the word and help steer folks toward any supplies we still need?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and point folks toward any supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah — I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know if anything else comes up. If you want, I can also send along a quick supplies update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, a quick supplies update would help. I’m a bit out of the loop, so just tell me what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — so far we could use extra screwdrivers, tape, and a few extension cords. If you can bring any of that, that’d be great, and I’ll keep you posted on anything else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can spread the word and bring any tools I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo — spreading the word helps a lot. If you can also bring any spare tools, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll spread the word and bring whatever spare tools I can find.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Cleo—I’ll keep you posted on the remaining supplies and send the updated list soon. Thanks again for helping keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rosa—I'll keep an eye out for the list and track anything still needed for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—I really appreciate it. I’ll send the updated list soon and let you know if anything else changes for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s been busy already, and I’m still keeping an ear out for the route and total stops. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you keeping an ear out. Once you have the route and total stops, just send them my way and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll send the route and stop count your way as soon as I hear it, and I’ll keep an eye out for any staffing updates too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and the paint and patch supplies later. If you find the screws, duct tape, and small tools first, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll look for the screws, duct tape, and small tools first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Uli — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and the paint and patch supplies later.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll bring them to the community center on Sunday. Thanks for keeping an eye out for extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been busy already—folks are really turning out for the repair drive. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, glad to hear it’s moving along. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll pass along any updates I hear, and thanks for keeping an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I can help spread the word a bit, but I’m keeping things pretty low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works — I’ll keep an eye on the route near Maple Hall on 3rd Street and let you know if anything changes about Saturday from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I appreciate you keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli—just a quick update: the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center now. Let me know if you can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa. I can help spread the word—please send me the time and any flyer details, and I’ll share them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send the time and flyer details over right away. Really appreciate you helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I’ll let people know the repair drive is coming up and that supplies are welcome if they can help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate that. I’ll send over the final repair list and time as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for the final list and time, and pass it along when you send it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly hands and a bit of organizing, if you can swing it. What part do you want to take on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with the hands part and some organizing too—point me where I’m needed most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — can you start by sorting the supplies and then help load the heavier stuff? I’ll point you to the busiest spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Just remind me what’s needed and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—thanks, Oren. I’ll spread the word and check what’s still needed for the repair drive, then I’ll let you know so you can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn. Just point me to the list when you have it, and I’ll see what I’ve got in the shed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus—I've got the repair drive marked for Sunday at the community center. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Cleo — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear of any extra tools or supplies we need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. Just send me any updates on tools or supplies, and I’ll keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Rey — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Could you look for the screws, duct tape, and small tools first? I can point out the repair spots after that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll look for the screws, duct tape, and small tools first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive. Just let me know what time you’re planning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — I’m planning for Saturday from 10 to 2 at Maple Hall on 3rd Street. If you can help around pickup and drop-off, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off on Saturday from 10 to 2. I’ll spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and keep spreading the word to a few neighbors. Hopefully we can get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — I still need the repair list and final time before I can help spread the word. Once we’ve confirmed those, I’m happy to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check on the repair list and final time, then I’ll pass them along. Once that’s confirmed, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: What’s the latest on the repair drive? I can bring something or help out if needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on, right? Is the main issue lining up more people, or is timing the bigger concern?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds like it’s still on — I’m guessing the bigger issue is getting enough people lined up. If you need, I can bring tools or help where it’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what’s the route, and which stop are we hitting first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Let’s start at the first stop and see who needs the most help. I can keep spreading the word and point people toward the repair drive supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, but I still need the full route before I can plan the drive time. How many stops are we doing in total?
